security_concerns.finding: Folder metadata admission tests for presence of DefaultImporter rather than enforcing an exclusive folder importer structure. A new generation folder meta containing both DefaultImporter and TextureImporter passes native_meta_plan. The C# gate likewise only checks matching lines. This does not satisfy the requested strict DefaultImporter-only new-folder role check. No native parser exploit is asserted.
security_concerns.evidence: adversarial-results.json, case folder DefaultImporter plus conflicting TextureImporter = ACCEPTED
security_concerns.recommendation: Reject conflicting/duplicate importer blocks and unexpected root-level role fields; independently test Python and C# positive ordinary folder metadata plus conflicting importer countercases.

logic_errors.finding: Final runner remains hardwired to .artifacts/performance-native-build-work, whereas player verifier imports only .artifacts/performance-operative-01. Copying these exact final sources into the intended operative bundle still loads/pins the old leaf guard/runner and writes action evidence in that old leaf. Guard required_tools is HERE-relative, so an operative-only trusted receipt cannot authenticate this entry path coherently.
logic_errors.recommendation: Align runner guard/evidence location with the actual reviewed operative bundle, fail closed on wrong installed location, and rerun full receipt/tool-pin tests on that exact installed layout. Do not silently edit the immutable old leaf.

logic_errors.finding: Ready timing validation is not strict: an otherwise accepted synthetic full reopen report still passes with readySeconds=-1, firstActualRepaintSeconds=-2, firstActualRepaintFrame=0 and progressFrameObserved="forged". Only ordering is checked; required timing/flag types, nonnegative finite times and actual positive first Repaint are not established by this validator. This permits malformed boot evidence to pass the declared report gate.
logic_errors.recommendation: Require exact field types, finite nonnegative boot times, positive actual Repaint frame, positive dimensions consistent with report, Boolean progress flag, and bounded finite operation progress. Add focused malformed ready.json cases.

suggestions: Parent bridge correctly resolves PerformanceBootTimingProbe, constructs a separate timing GameObject root, and checks exactly one timing component not on coordinator GameObject. For stronger future scene-admission checking also require timing.transform.root != coordinator.transform.root; the emitted builder scene itself already has separate roots.
Build driver closure dictionary comprehensions should explicitly reject duplicate compilerPins/candidatePins rows, as the native runner already does, rather than collapsing duplicates.
Keep quit-while-busy, owner reentry, focus/pause and Binder import native acceptance separate. Existing normal idle quit/reopen is not evidence for these cases.
Native progress visibility, real worker JsonUtility, responsiveness, GPU pixel captures and durability remain unexecuted; compilation and pure/managed fixture passes are not native proof.
